headline: Students stop runaway bus when driver suffers medical emergency
meta_description: Quick-thinking students in Western Pennsylvania pressed the brake when their bus driver suffered a medical emergency, preventing a dangerous situation.
summary_short: Students in Hollidaysburg, Pennsylvania sprang into action when their bus driver had a medical emergency. They noticed something was wrong when the bus rolled past a sto…
body:
Students in Western Pennsylvania acted quickly when their bus driver suffered a medical emergency behind the wheel, pressing the brake to stop the vehicle and prevent disaster.

The incident happened last month in Hollidaysburg Area School District. The students recognized danger when the bus rolled right past a stop—an unusual sign that something was wrong. That quick awareness led them to take action, reaching for the brake themselves.

A video of the moment has now been released by the school district, giving voice to the students involved. Their fast thinking and willingness to help transformed what could have been a tragedy into a story of young people stepping up when it mattered most.

Students noticed bus rolling past a stop sign
